card.line: Corinth was a wealthy Greek city where Paul stayed to teach about Jesus and started a church, and he later wrote two letters to the believers there.

moments.title: Paul Arrives in Corinth
moments.text: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth. There he met Aquila and Priscilla, who were tentmakers like him, and he stayed and worked with them.

moments.title: Paul Turns to the Gentiles
moments.text: Every Sabbath Paul reasoned in the synagogue, and after Silas and Timothy came he testified that Jesus is the Christ. When people opposed and insulted him, he left and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.

moments.title: Apollos in Corinth
moments.text: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul passed through the interior and came to Ephesus. There he found some disciples who had not heard of the Holy Spirit, and they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

problems.problem: Moment 2's passage Acts 18:4-7 doesn't include a verse that names Corinth in the lessons.
